# 2. Filter Cells based on #genes, #UMI, %mitochondrial


Subset to only cells:

with at least X genes : thresX <- quantile(Cord@meta.data$nFeature_RNA, 0.05)
with at least Y UMIs : thresY <- quantile(Cord@meta.data$nCount_RNA, 0.05)
less than Z UMIs (remove doublet) : thresZ <- as.integer(mean(Cord@meta.datanCountRNA)+2∗sd(Cord@meta.data
nCount_RNA));
with less than 5% mitochondrial UMIs

```{r}
thresX <- 250 # quantile(Liver_big_sub@meta.data$nFeature_RNA, 0.05) # by default nGene >= 250
thresY <- 500 # quantile(Liver_big_sub@meta.data$nCount_RNA, 0.05) # by default nUMI >= 500
thresZ <- as.integer(mean(Liver_big_sub@meta.data$nCount_RNA) + 2*sd(Liver_big_sub@meta.data$nCount_RNA)) #this can be skipped or included
thresM <- 20 # you can increase up to 20

hist(Liver_big_sub@meta.data$nFeature_RNA, 200);abline(v=thresX, col="red")
hist(Liver_big_sub@meta.data$nCount_RNA, 200);abline(v=thresY, col="red");abline(v=thresZ, col="red")
hist(Liver_big_sub@meta.data$percent.mito, 200);abline(v=thresM, col="red")

VlnPlot(Liver_big_sub, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), split.by='sample', group.by='sample') + geom_hline(yintercept = thresX)
VlnPlot(Liver_big_sub, features = c("nCount_RNA"), split.by='sample', group.by='sample') + geom_hline(yintercept = c(thresY, thresZ))
VlnPlot(Liver_big_sub, features = c("percent.mito"), split.by='sample', group.by='sample') + geom_hline(yintercept = thresM)


Liver_big_sub.cut <- subset(Liver_big_sub, subset = nFeature_RNA > thresX)
Liver_big_sub.cut <- subset(Liver_big_sub.cut, subset = nCount_RNA > thresY)
Liver_big_sub.cut <- subset(Liver_big_sub.cut, subset = nCount_RNA < thresZ)
Liver_big_sub.cut <- subset(Liver_big_sub.cut, subset = percent.mito < thresM)

#Plot
dittoScatterPlot(
    x.var = "nCount_RNA", y.var = "nFeature_RNA", color.var = "percent.mito",
    object = Liver_big_sub, cells.use = colnames(Liver_big_sub.cut), show.others = TRUE)
    
    
multi_dittoPlot(
    c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mito", "percent.ribo"),
    group.by = "orig.ident", color.by = "orig.ident",
    object = Liver_big_sub.cut,
    ncol = 2)
    
##specify that we will perform downstream analysis on the filtered data
Liver_big_sub <- Liver_big_sub.cut
        
```

Part3. Unsupervised clustering
** Normalize and scale the objects     
Liver_big_sub <- NormalizeData(Liver_big_sub, verbose = FALSE)
Liver_big_sub <- FindVariableFeatures(Liver_big_sub, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Run the standard workflow for visualization and clustering
  all.genes <- rownames(Liver_big_sub)
  Liver_big_sub <- ScaleData(Liver_big_sub, features = all.genes)
  Liver_big_sub <- RunPCA(Liver_big_sub, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
  print(Liver_big_sub[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
  
  
	VizDimLoadings(Liver_big_sub, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")  
	DimPlot(Liver_big_sub, reduction = "pca")
	
	
	 
#Determine the ‘dimensionality’ of the dataset
  Liver_big_sub <- JackStraw(Liver_big_sub, num.replicate = 100, dims=60)
  Liver_big_sub <- ScoreJackStraw(Liver_big_sub, dims = 1:30)
  JackStrawPlot(Liver_big_sub, dims = 1:30)	 
  ElbowPlot(Liver_big_sub, ndims=30)	 


# t-SNE
  Liver_big_sub <- RunTSNE(Liver_big_sub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
# UMAP
  Liver_big_sub <- RunUMAP(Liver_big_sub, reduction = "pca",dims = 1:30)  
  
# Clustering
  #We find that setting this parameter between 0.4-1.2 typically returns good results for single-cell datasets of around 3K cells. Optimal resolution often increases for larger datasets. The clusters can be found using the Idents() function.
  
  Liver_big_sub <- FindNeighbors(Liver_big_sub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
  Liver_big_sub <- FindClusters(Liver_big_sub, resolution = 0.4)	
  
  
# Plot
  dittoDimPlot(Liver_big_sub, "RNA_snn_res.0.4", reduction.use = "tsne")

  dittoDimPlot(Liver_big_sub, "RNA_snn_res.0.4", reduction.use = "umap")

## Part5. Cell-type annotation using singleR ##
```{r}
library(celldex)
library(SingleR)
DefaultAssay(Liver_big_sub) <- "RNA"


# Obtain the premade BlueprintEncode reference set which contains immune and hematopoietic cells
  blueprint.encode <- BlueprintEncodeData()
  monaco.ref <- celldex::MonacoImmuneData()
  dice.ref <- celldex::DatabaseImmuneCellExpressionData()
  ImmGenData.ref <- celldex::ImmGenData()
  Novershtern.ref <- celldex::NovershternHematopoieticData()
  HPCA.ref <- celldex::HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData()
  
#Run SingleR (HPCA)
HPCA <- SingleR(test = as.SingleCellExperiment(Liver_big_sub),
                     ref = HPCA.ref,
                     labels = HPCA.ref$label.fine)

HPCA <- SingleR(test = as.SingleCellExperiment(Liver_big_sub),
                     ref = HPCA.ref,
                     labels = HPCA.ref$label.main)
                     
                     
# Grab labels, but change pruned NAs to character "NA"s
Liver_big_sub@meta.data$HPCA <- HPCA$labels
dittoDimPlot(Liver_big_sub, "HPCA",
             reduction.use = "umap",
             do.letter = FALSE,
             cells.use = !is.na(HPCA$pruned.labels),
             do.label = TRUE)



  #saveRDS(Liver_big_sub, file = "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/script/Liver_big_sub.rds")
  #Liver_big_sub <- readRDS(file = "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/script/Liver_big_sub.rds")
  



library(ggplot2)
# Basic barplot
df <- as.matrix(table(HPCA$labels))
df <- as.data.frame(df)
colnames(df) <- 'count'
df$celltype <- rownames(df)

p<-ggplot(data=df, aes(x=celltype, y=count)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity")
p
```

## 12. Marker gene heatmap based on MultiK result

library(dplyr)
DefaultAssay(mergedObj) <- "RNA"
Idents(mergedObj) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.9"
mergedObj <- ScaleData(mergedObj, verbose = FALSE, features = rownames(mergedObj))

mergedObj_markers2_0.9 <- FindAllMarkers(mergedObj, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
mergedObj_markers2_0.9 %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)

mergedObj_markers2_0.9 %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC) -> top10

DoHeatmap(mergedObj, features = top10$gene) + NoLegend()

## Cell type composition for different disease groups

mergedObj@meta.data$disease <- 'NAFLD'
merged_meta <- mergedObj[[]]
merged_meta[merged_meta$sample=='Liver_4_23',ncol(merged_meta)] <- 'AIH'
merged_meta[merged_meta$sample=='Liver_4_32',ncol(merged_meta)] <- 'AIH'
merged_meta[merged_meta$sample=='Liver_4_24',ncol(merged_meta)] <- 'PBC'

```{r}
##Load Liver Cell Atlas

    LCA_meta[i,13] <- LCA_table[which(LCA_table[,7]==LCA_meta[i,4]),9]
    LCA_meta[i,14] <- LCA_table[which(LCA_table[,7]==LCA_meta[i,4]),10]

}
```

```{r}
setwd('/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/TCR_BCR_seq/Liver_TCR_data')

#Loading libraries
  suppressMessages(library(scRepertoire))
  suppressMessages(library(Seurat))
  
#Loading contig data
  cont_Liver_1_103 <- read.csv("Liver_1_103_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")
  cont_Liver_1_104 <- read.csv("Liver_1_104_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")
  cont_Liver_4_20 <- read.csv("Liver_4_20_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")
  cont_Liver_4_21 <- read.csv("Liver_4_21_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")  
  cont_Liver_4_23 <- read.csv("Liver_4_23_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv") 
  cont_Liver_4_24 <- read.csv("Liver_4_24_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")   
  cont_Liver_4_28 <- read.csv("Liver_4_28_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")
  cont_Liver_4_29 <- read.csv("Liver_4_29_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")  
  cont_Liver_4_30 <- read.csv("Liver_4_30_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")  
  cont_Liver_4_31 <- read.csv("Liver_4_31_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")  
  cont_Liver_4_32 <- read.csv("Liver_4_32_TCR_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")  
  
  contig_list_TCR <- list(cont_Liver_1_103, cont_Liver_1_104, cont_Liver_4_21, cont_Liver_4_23, cont_Liver_4_24, cont_Liver_4_28, cont_Liver_4_29, cont_Liver_4_30, cont_Liver_4_31, cont_Liver_4_32)
  
  combined_TCR <- combineTCR(contig_list_TCR, samples = c("Liver_1_103", "Liver_1_104", "Liver_4_21", "Liver_4_23", "Liver_4_24", "Liver_4_28", "Liver_4_29", "Liver_4_30", "Liver_4_31", "Liver_4_32"), ID = c("Liver_1_103", "Liver_1_104", "Liver_4_21", "Liver_4_23", "Liver_4_24", "Liver_4_28", "Liver_4_29", "Liver_4_30", "Liver_4_31", "Liver_4_32"), cells ="T-AB")

#Visualizing contigs
  #1. Quantify Clonotypes
  quantContig(combined_TCR, cloneCall="gene", scale = T)
  quantContig(combined_TCR, cloneCall="gene", scale = F)
  quantContig_output <- quantContig(combined_TCR, cloneCall="gene", 
                            scale = T, exportTable = T)
  
  #2. Clonotype Abundance
  abundanceContig(combined_TCR, cloneCall = "gene", scale = F)

  #3. Length of Clonotypes
  lengthContig(combined_TCR, cloneCall="aa")
  lengthContig(combined_TCR, cloneCall="nt") 
  
  #4. Compare Clonotypes
  compareClonotypes(combined_TCR, 
                  numbers = 10, 
                  samples = c("Liver_1_103", "Liver_1_104", "Liver_4_21", "Liver_4_23", "Liver_4_24", "Liver_4_28", "Liver_4_29", "Liver_4_30", "Liver_4_31", "Liver_4_32"), 
                  cloneCall="gene", 
                  graph = "alluvial")
  
  ##5. Visualizing gene usage
  
  vizGenes(combined_TCR, gene = "V", 
         chain = "TRB", 
         plot = "bar", 
         order = "variance", 
         scale = TRUE)

#write.table(combined$Naive_7_Naive_7, file = "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Tcell/cellranger/TCR_analysis/TCR_Naive_7.txt", row.names = TRUE, col.names = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)  
#write.table(combined$Naive_7_12_18_Naive_7_12_18, file = "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Tcell/cellranger/TCR_analysis/TCR_Naive_7_12_18.txt", row.names = TRUE, col.names = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)   

  
## More Advanced Clonal Analysis
  # Clonal Space Homeostasis
  clonalHomeostasis(combined_TCR, cloneCall = "gene", 
                  cloneTypes = c(Rare = 1e-04, 
                                 Small = 0.001, 
                                 Medium = 0.01, 
                                 Large = 0.1, 
                                 Hyperexpanded = 1))
  
  ##Diversity analysis
  clonalDiversity(combined_TCR, 
                cloneCall = "gene", 
                group.by = "sample", 
                x.axis = "ID", 
                n.boots = 100)
```

## 19-2. Filter Cells based on #genes, #UMI, %mitochondrial


Subset to only cells:

with at least X genes : thresX <- quantile(Cord@meta.data$nFeature_RNA, 0.05)
with at least Y UMIs : thresY <- quantile(Cord@meta.data$nCount_RNA, 0.05)
less than Z UMIs (remove doublet) : thresZ <- as.integer(mean(Cord@meta.datanCountRNA)+2∗sd(Cord@meta.data
nCount_RNA));
with less than 5% mitochondrial UMIs

```{r}
thresX <- 250 # quantile(Liver_big_sub@meta.data$nFeature_RNA, 0.05) # by default nGene >= 250
thresY <- 500 # quantile(Liver_big_sub@meta.data$nCount_RNA, 0.05) # by default nUMI >= 500
thresZ <- as.integer(mean(Liver_merged_features@meta.data$nCount_RNA) + 2*sd(Liver_merged_features@meta.data$nCount_RNA)) #this can be skipped or included
thresM <- 20 # you can increase up to 20

hist(Liver_merged_features@meta.data$nFeature_RNA, 200);abline(v=thresX, col="red")
hist(Liver_merged_features@meta.data$nCount_RNA, 200);abline(v=thresY, col="red");abline(v=thresZ, col="red")
hist(Liver_merged_features@meta.data$percent.mito, 200);abline(v=thresM, col="red")

VlnPlot(Liver_merged_features, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), split.by='sample', group.by='sample') + geom_hline(yintercept = thresX)
VlnPlot(Liver_merged_features, features = c("nCount_RNA"), split.by='sample', group.by='sample') + geom_hline(yintercept = c(thresY, thresZ))
VlnPlot(Liver_merged_features, features = c("percent.mito"), split.by='sample', group.by='sample') + geom_hline(yintercept = thresM)


Liver_merged_features.cut <- subset(Liver_merged_features, subset = nFeature_RNA > thresX)
Liver_merged_features.cut <- subset(Liver_merged_features.cut, subset = nCount_RNA > thresY)
Liver_merged_features.cut <- subset(Liver_merged_features.cut, subset = nCount_RNA < thresZ)
Liver_merged_features.cut <- subset(Liver_merged_features.cut, subset = percent.mito < thresM)

#Plot
dittoScatterPlot(
    x.var = "nCount_RNA", y.var = "nFeature_RNA", color.var = "percent.mito",
    object = Liver_merged_features, cells.use = colnames(Liver_merged_features.cut), show.others = TRUE)
```

## 20. Subclustering of MP cells (7119 cells)
```{r}
mergedObj_MP <- subset(mergedObj_sub, subset = (cellannot == "MP"))

mergedObj_MP_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = mergedObj_MP, slot = "counts")
  mergedObj_MP_new <- CreateSeuratObject(
    mergedObj_MP_matrix,
    project = "CreateSeuratObject",
    assay = "RNA"
  )

## Part3. Unsupervised clustering
## Normalize and scale the objects     

  
mergedObj_MP_new <- NormalizeData(mergedObj_MP_new, verbose = FALSE)
mergedObj_MP_new <- FindVariableFeatures(mergedObj_MP_new, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Run the standard workflow for visualization and clustering
  all.genes <- rownames(mergedObj_MP_new)
  mergedObj_MP_new <- ScaleData(mergedObj_MP_new, features = all.genes)
  mergedObj_MP_new <- RunPCA(mergedObj_MP_new, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
  print(mergedObj_MP_new[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
  
  
	VizDimLoadings(mergedObj_MP_new, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")  
	DimPlot(mergedObj_MP_new, reduction = "pca")
	
	
	 
#Determine the ‘dimensionality’ of the dataset
  #mergedObj_MP_new <- JackStraw(mergedObj_MP_new, num.replicate = 100, dims=60)
  #mergedObj_MP_new <- ScoreJackStraw(mergedObj_MP_new, dims = 1:30)
  #JackStrawPlot(mergedObj_MP_new, dims = 1:30)	 
  ElbowPlot(mergedObj_MP_new, ndims=30)	 


# t-SNE
  mergedObj_MP_new <- RunTSNE(mergedObj_MP_new, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
# UMAP
  mergedObj_MP_new <- RunUMAP(mergedObj_MP_new, reduction = "pca",dims = 1:30)  
  
# Clustering
  #We find that setting this parameter between 0.4-1.2 typically returns good results for single-cell datasets of around 3K cells. Optimal resolution often increases for larger datasets. The clusters can be found using the Idents() function.
  
  mergedObj_MP_new <- FindNeighbors(mergedObj_MP_new, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
  mergedObj_MP_new <- FindClusters(mergedObj_MP_new, resolution = 0.4)	
  mergedObj_MP_new <- FindClusters(mergedObj_MP_new, resolution = 0.8)	
  mergedObj_MP_new <- FindClusters(mergedObj_MP_new, resolution = 0.2)
  mergedObj_MP_new <- FindClusters(mergedObj_MP_new, resolution = 0.1)
```

```{r}
  data_tmp1 <- cbind(data[,c(1,3)], 'C1');colnames(data_tmp1) <- c('Term', 'p.adjust', 'Cluster')
  data_tmp2 <- cbind(data[,c(1,4)], 'C2');colnames(data_tmp2) <- c('Term', 'p.adjust', 'Cluster')
  data_tmp3 <- cbind(data[,c(1,5)], 'C3');colnames(data_tmp3) <- c('Term', 'p.adjust', 'Cluster')
  data_tmp4 <- cbind(data[,c(1,6)], 'C4');colnames(data_tmp4) <- c('Term', 'p.adjust', 'Cluster')
  data_tmp6 <- cbind(data[,c(1,7)], 'C6');colnames(data_tmp6) <- c('Term', 'p.adjust', 'Cluster')
  data_tmp <- rbind(data_tmp0, data_tmp1, data_tmp2, data_tmp3, data_tmp4, data_tmp6)
  data_tmp$score <- -log10(data_tmp$p.adjust)
  
  data_tmp$Term <- factor(data_tmp$Term, levels=data[,1])
  data_tmp$Cluster <- factor(data_tmp$Cluster, levels=c('C0', 'C1', 'C2', 'C3', 'C4', 'C6'))
  data_tmp[data_tmp[,4]>5,4] <- 5 ## Ceiling the data

library(ggplot2)
S1<- ggplot(data_tmp, aes(x= Cluster, y=Term, size = 1, color=score, group=Cluster)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.8) + 
theme_classic()
```

#Fisher's exact test
annot_integrate_flat_healthy <- annot_integrate_flat[annot_integrate_flat$sample=='healthy',]
annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD <- annot_integrate_flat[annot_integrate_flat$sample=='NAFLD',]


	# This is for M0 ~ M9
	result_real <- matrix(0, 10, 2)
	for (i in 1:10){
	  hitInSample <- annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD[i,1]
	  hitInPop <- annot_integrate_flat_healthy[i,1]
	  failInPop <- sum(annot_integrate_flat_healthy$count)-hitInPop
	  sampleSize <- sum(annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD$count)
	  result_real[i,1] <- fisher.test(matrix(c(hitInSample, hitInPop, sampleSize-hitInSample, failInPop), 2, 2), alternative='greater')$p.value; 
	  result_real[i,2] <- fisher.test(matrix(c(hitInSample, hitInPop, sampleSize-hitInSample, failInPop), 2, 2), alternative='less')$p.value;
  }
  
  result_real <- as.data.frame(result_real)
  rownames(result_real) <- c('M0', 'M1', 'M2', 'M3', 'M4', 'M5', 'M6', 'M7', 'M8', 'M9')
  colnames(result_real) <- c('enrichment', 'depletion')
  result_real$enrichment_adjust <- p.adjust(result_real[,1], method = 'BH')
  result_real$depletion_adjust <- p.adjust(result_real[,2], method = 'BH')

#Fisher's exact test
annot_integrate_flat_healthy <- annot_integrate_flat[annot_integrate_flat$sample=='healthy',]
annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD <- annot_integrate_flat[annot_integrate_flat$sample=='NAFLD',]


	# This is for E0 ~ E6
	result_real <- matrix(0, 7, 2)
	for (i in 1:7){
	  hitInSample <- annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD[i,1]
	  hitInPop <- annot_integrate_flat_healthy[i,1]
	  failInPop <- sum(annot_integrate_flat_healthy$count)-hitInPop
	  sampleSize <- sum(annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD$count)
	  result_real[i,1] <- fisher.test(matrix(c(hitInSample, hitInPop, sampleSize-hitInSample, failInPop), 2, 2), alternative='greater')$p.value; 
	  result_real[i,2] <- fisher.test(matrix(c(hitInSample, hitInPop, sampleSize-hitInSample, failInPop), 2, 2), alternative='less')$p.value;
  }
  
  result_real <- as.data.frame(result_real)
  rownames(result_real) <- c('E0', 'E1', 'E2', 'E3', 'E4', 'E5', 'E6')
  colnames(result_real) <- c('enrichment', 'depletion')
  result_real$enrichment_adjust <- p.adjust(result_real[,1], method = 'BH')
  result_real$depletion_adjust <- p.adjust(result_real[,2], method = 'BH')

```{r}
  mergedObj_Mes_new <- FindNeighbors(mergedObj_Mes_new, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
  mergedObj_Mes_new <- FindClusters(mergedObj_Mes_new, resolution = 0.4)	
  mergedObj_Mes_new <- FindClusters(mergedObj_Mes_new, resolution = 0.8)	
  mergedObj_Mes_new <- FindClusters(mergedObj_Mes_new, resolution = 0.2)
  mergedObj_Mes_new <- FindClusters(mergedObj_Mes_new, resolution = 0.1)
```

#Fisher's exact test
annot_integrate_flat_healthy <- annot_integrate_flat[annot_integrate_flat$sample=='healthy',]
annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD <- annot_integrate_flat[annot_integrate_flat$sample=='NAFLD',]


	# This is for T cell types
	result_real <- matrix(0, 15, 2)
	for (i in 1:15){
	  hitInSample <- annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD[i,1]
	  hitInPop <- annot_integrate_flat_healthy[i,1]
	  failInPop <- sum(annot_integrate_flat_healthy$count)-hitInPop
	  sampleSize <- sum(annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD$count)
	  result_real[i,1] <- fisher.test(matrix(c(hitInSample, hitInPop, sampleSize-hitInSample, failInPop), 2, 2), alternative='greater')$p.value; 
	  result_real[i,2] <- fisher.test(matrix(c(hitInSample, hitInPop, sampleSize-hitInSample, failInPop), 2, 2), alternative='less')$p.value;
  }
  
  result_real <- as.data.frame(result_real)
  rownames(result_real) <- annot_integrate_flat_NAFLD$cluster
  colnames(result_real) <- c('enrichment', 'depletion')
  result_real$enrichment_adjust <- p.adjust(result_real[,1], method = 'BH')
  result_real$depletion_adjust <- p.adjust(result_real[,2], method = 'BH')


write.table(result_real, file = "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/Integration_Nature_2019/Analysis/mergedObj_metadata_T_filtered_fisher_exact.txt", row.names = TRUE, col.names = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

```{r}
## Clustering based on pseudotime trajectory (tradeSeq)
#https://statomics.github.io/tradeSeq/articles/tradeSeq.html

library(tradeSeq)
library(RColorBrewer)

library(monocle3)


  mergedObj <- readRDS(file = "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/script/Liver_merged_features_mergedObj_MP.rds")
  Idents(mergedObj) <- 'RNA_snn_res.0.15'
  DimPlot(mergedObj, reduction = "umap", label = FALSE, pt.size = .1, raster=FALSE)


  DefaultAssay(mergedObj) <- "RNA"
  mergedObj_count <- GetAssayData(object = mergedObj, slot = "counts")


  expression_matrix <- mergedObj_count
  cell_metadata <- mergedObj[[]]
  gene_annotation <- as.data.frame(rownames(expression_matrix))
  rownames(gene_annotation) <- rownames(expression_matrix)
  colnames(gene_annotation) <- 'gene_short_name'

  #cds <- new_cell_data_set(expression_matrix,
  #                       cell_metadata = cell_metadata,
  #                       gene_metadata = gene_annotation)

  
  cds <- readRDS(file = "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/Integration_Nature_2019/Analysis/Monocle/Liver.recombined.monocle3_20230712_MP.rds")

  # We find all the cells that are close to the starting point
  cell_ids <- colnames(cds)[cell_metadata$RNA_snn_res.0.15 ==  "4"]
  closest_vertex <- cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds), ])
  closest_vertex <- closest_vertex[cell_ids, ]
  closest_vertex <- as.numeric(names(which.max(table(closest_vertex))))
  mst <- principal_graph(cds)$UMAP
  root_pr_nodes <- igraph::V(mst)$name[closest_vertex]

  # We compute the trajectory
  cds <- order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes = root_pr_nodes)
  plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "pseudotime")

  
## Extracting the pseudotimes and cell weights for tradeSeq
  
  library(magrittr)
  
  # Get the closest vertice for every cell
  y_to_cells <-  principal_graph_aux(cds)$UMAP$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex %>%
  as.data.frame()
  y_to_cells$cells <- rownames(y_to_cells)
  y_to_cells$Y <- y_to_cells$V1

  # Get the root vertices
  # It is the same node as above
  root <- cds@principal_graph_aux$UMAP$root_pr_nodes

  # Get the other endpoints
  endpoints <- names(which(igraph::degree(mst) == 1))
  endpoints <- endpoints[!endpoints %in% root] #"Y_3"  "Y_20"
  endpoints <- "Y_20"

  # For each endpoint
  cellWeights <- lapply(endpoints, function(endpoint) {
  
    # We find the path between the endpoint and the root
    path <- igraph::shortest_paths(mst, root, endpoint)$vpath[[1]]
    path <- as.character(path)
    # We find the cells that map along that path
    df <- y_to_cells[y_to_cells$Y %in% path, ]
    df <- data.frame(weights = as.numeric(colnames(cds) %in% df$cells))
    colnames(df) <- endpoint
    return(df)
    }) %>% do.call(what = 'cbind', args = .) %>%
    as.matrix()
  rownames(cellWeights) <- colnames(cds)
  pseudotime <- matrix(pseudotime(cds), ncol = ncol(cellWeights),
                     nrow = ncol(cds), byrow = FALSE)
  cellWeights[,1] <- 1
  #cellWeights[,2] <- 1
  sce <- fitGAM(counts = expression_matrix,
              pseudotime = pseudotime,
              cellWeights = cellWeights)


#saveRDS(sce, file = "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/Integration_Nature_2019/Analysis/Monocle/Liver.recombined.monocle3_fitGAM_20230924_MP_v2.rds")
#sce <- readRDS(file = "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/Integration_Nature_2019/Analysis/Monocle/Liver.recombined.monocle3_fitGAM_20230924_MP_v2.rds")
  
  
## Within-lineage comparisons
  # Association of gene expression with pseudotime
  # A first exploration of the data analysis may consist of checking whether gene expression is associated with a particular lineage. The statistical test performed here, implemented in the associationTest function, is testing the null hypothesis that all smoother coefficients are equal to each other. This can be interpreted as testing whether the average gene expression is significantly changing along pseudotime.
  
  assoRes <- associationTest(sce)
  head(assoRes)
  assoRes$p.adjust <- p.adjust(assoRes$pvalue, method='BH')
  assoRes_Diff <- assoRes[which(assoRes$p.adjust<0.05),]
  
  # Discovering progenitor marker genes
  # In order to discover marker genes of the progenitor or differentiated cell population, researchers may be interested in assessing differential expression between the progenitor cell population (starting point of a lineage) with the differentiated cell type population (the end point of a lineage). The function startVsEndTest uses a Wald test to assess the null hypothesis that the average expression at the starting point of the smoother (progenitor population) is equal to the average expression at the end point of the smoother (differentiated population). The test basically involves a comparison between two smoother coefficients for every lineage. The function startVsEndTest performs a global test across all lineages by default (i.e. it compares the start and end positions for all lineages simultaneously), but you can also assess all lineages separately by setting lineages = TRUE.
  
  startRes <- startVsEndTest(sce)
  oStart <- order(startRes$waldStat, decreasing = TRUE)
  sigGeneStart <- names(sce)[oStart[3]]
  plotSmoothers(sce, expression_matrix, gene = sigGeneStart)

  # Comparing specific pseudotime values within a lineage
  customRes <- startVsEndTest(sce, pseudotimeValues = c(1, 30))
  
## Between-lineage comparisons
  # Discovering differentiated cell type markers

## Clustering of genes according to their expression pattern
  # Extracting fitted values to use with any clustering method
  yhat <- predictCells(models = sce, gene = rownames(expression_matrix))
  ysmooth <- predictSmooth(models = sce, gene = rownames(expression_matrix), nPoints = 40, tidy = FALSE)
  #write.table(yhat, "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/Integration_Nature_2019/Analysis/Monocle/yhat_v2.txt", row.names = TRUE, col.names = TRUE, sep="\t", quote = FALSE)
  #write.table(ysmooth, "/Users/jeong/Documents/new_contract_HY_IBB/Collaboration/Liver/Integration_Nature_2019/Analysis/Monocle/ysmooth_v2.txt", row.names = TRUE, col.names = TRUE, sep="\t", quote = FALSE)
  
  # Clustering using RSEC, clusterExperiment
  library(clusterExperiment)
  nPointsClus <- 20
  clusPat <- clusterExpressionPatterns(sce, nPoints = nPointsClus,
                                     genes = rownames(assoRes_Diff))
  
  clusterLabels <- primaryCluster(clusPat$rsec)
  
  
  cUniq <- unique(clusterLabels)
  cUniq <- cUniq[!cUniq == -1] # remove unclustered genes

for (xx in cUniq[1:4]) {
  cId <- which(clusterLabels == xx)
  p <- ggplot(data = data.frame(x = 1:nPointsClus,
                                y = rep(range(clusPat$yhatScaled[cId, ]),
                                        nPointsClus / 2)),
              aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0) +
    labs(title = paste0("Cluster ", xx),  x = "Pseudotime", y = "Normalized expression") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  for (ii in 1:length(cId)) {
    geneId <- rownames(clusPat$yhatScaled)[cId[ii]]
    p <- p +
      geom_line(data = data.frame(x = rep(1:nPointsClus, 2),
                                  y = clusPat$yhatScaled[geneId, ],
                                  lineage = rep(0:1, each = nPointsClus)),
                aes(col = as.character(lineage), group = lineage), lwd = 1.5)
  }
  p <- p + guides(color = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("orange", "darkseagreen3"),
                       breaks = c("0", "1"))  
  print(p)
}
```
